title: ForbiddenLogKeyExamples
description: Word-split examples for forbidden-log-keys.json (planning/11 §8, planning/14 §2): the one set of log keys every matcher (the API logger, the worker logger, the forbidden-field lint) and its tests check against. A key is forbidden when the whole key, or any of its camelCase, snake_case or kebab-case words, lowercased, equals a registry word; whole words only, so a word inside a longer word does not match. `forbidden` keys must match; `allowed` keys must not. Add examples freely; removing one weakens every canary that reads this file.

forbidden.description: Log keys every matcher MUST treat as forbidden (camel, snake, kebab and UPPER variants)

allowed.description: Log keys every matcher must NOT treat as forbidden: the doc 14 §2 required ids and near-misses that contain a registry word only inside a longer word
